description: This file contains extension methods for integrating ADO.NET based reminder storage into an Orleans silo builder. It provides methods to configure services for reminders, including setting up options and dependencies necessary for ADO.NET-based reminder storage.

classes.name: SiloBuilderReminderExtensions
classes.description: Contains extension methods for configuring ADO.NET reminder storage on an Orleans silo builder.

methods.name: UseAdoNetReminderService
methods.description: Configures the Orleans silo builder to use ADO.NET for reminder storage, accepting a configuration delegate for setting table options.

methods.name: UseAdoNetReminderService
methods.description: Overload that accepts a delegate to configure OptionsBuilder for AdoNetReminderTableOptions, forwarding to service configuration.

methods.name: UseAdoNetReminderService
methods.description: Extension method on IServiceCollection to set up ADO.NET reminder storage, adding necessary services and configuring options.
